choices.content: There exists a real number that is not greater than 0
All real numbers are not greater than 0
There exists a real number that is greater than 0
All real numbers are less than 0

question.prompt: What is the negation of “All real numbers are greater than 0”?

solutions.explanation: The negation of a universal statement is an existential statement, with the conclusion also negated. It does not simply change “all” to “all are not.”
solutions.title: Negating a universal statement
